title: Analytic description of the moving moisture front in soils
summary: The fact that moisture propagates in soils at a finite speed is confirmed by natural everyday experience as well as by controlled laboratory tests. In this text, we rigorously derive analytical upper bounds for the speed of moisture front propagation under gravity for the solution to the Richards equation with compactly supported initial data. The main result is an explicit criterion describing a competition between gravity and capillarity, where the dominant effect is determined by the characteristics of the soil.
